transforms.name: rename-selector-items-to-options
transforms.title: Rename Selector items → options
transforms.description: Renames the `items` prop on XDSSelector to `options`.

transforms.name: unify-visibility-to-onOpenChange
transforms.title: Unify visibility callbacks → onOpenChange
transforms.description: Renames onHide, onClose, onShow, onToggle, onMenuToggle to onOpenChange across dialog, menu, popover, and tooltip components.

transforms.name: unify-uncontrolled-to-defaultX
transforms.title: Unify uncontrolled state → defaultX pattern
transforms.description: Renames initialIsSideNavCollapsed, initialIsOpen, initialIsExpanded to their defaultX equivalents.

transforms.name: rename-banner-endButton-to-endContent
transforms.title: Rename Banner endButton → endContent
transforms.description: Renames the `endButton` prop on XDSBanner to `endContent`.

transforms.name: rename-form-tooltip-startIcon
transforms.title: Rename form tooltip → labelTooltip, startIcon → labelIcon
transforms.description: Renames `tooltip` to `labelTooltip` and `startIcon` to `labelIcon` on form field components.

transforms.name: rename-isShown-to-isOpen
transforms.title: Rename isShown → isOpen
transforms.description: Renames the `isShown` prop to `isOpen` on XDSDialog and XDSPopover for consistency.

transforms.name: rename-topnav-title-to-heading
transforms.title: Rename TopNav title → heading, XDSTopNavTitle → XDSTopNavHeading
transforms.description: Renames the `title` prop to `heading` on XDSTopNav and XDSTopNavTitle/XDSTopNavHeading, renames the XDSTopNavTitle component to XDSTopNavHeading, and updates import specifiers.

transforms.name: rename-sidenav-header-to-heading
transforms.title: Rename SideNav header → heading, XDSSideNavHeader → XDSSideNavHeading
transforms.description: Renames props (title → heading, titleHref → headingHref, supertitle → superheading, etc.) on XDSSideNavHeader/XDSSideNavHeading, renames the component, and updates import specifiers.

transforms.name: migrate-useXDSIcon-to-getIcon
transforms.title: Migrate useXDSIcon → getIcon, remove IconRegistryContext
transforms.description: Renames useXDSIcon() to getIcon(), updates import sources from IconRegistry to globalIconRegistry, and removes IconRegistryContext usage.

transforms.name: migrate-gap-to-numeric
transforms.title: Migrate gap to numeric scale
transforms.description: Migrates gap, rowGap, and columnGap props from string tokens (e.g. "space4") to numeric values (e.g. 4).

transforms.name: migrate-isFullBleed-to-padding
transforms.title: Migrate isFullBleed to padding={0}
transforms.description: Replaces `isFullBleed` with `padding={0}` on layout components. Does not touch XDSDivider.

transforms.name: migrate-badge-dot-to-statusdot
transforms.title: Migrate Badge dot → StatusDot
transforms.description: Converts XDSBadge shape="dot" to XDSStatusDot.

transforms.name: migrate-collapse-to-collapsible
transforms.title: Migrate collapse props to collapsible
transforms.description: Replaces `isCollapsible` + related props on XDSSideNav with the unified `collapsible` prop. Removes deprecated AppShell collapse props.

transforms.name: migrate-radius-tokens
transforms.title: Migrate semantic radius tokens to numeric scale
transforms.description: Renames --radius-inner/content/element/container/page to --radius-0/1/2/3/4.

transforms.name: migrate-skeleton-radius
transforms.title: Migrate XDSSkeleton radius prop to numeric scale
transforms.description: Replaces semantic radius prop values (inner, content, element, container) with numeric equivalents (0, 1, 2, 3).

transforms.name: migrate-shadow-tokens
transforms.title: Migrate elevation tokens to shadow semantic naming
transforms.description: Renames --elevation-* to --shadow-base/menu/hover/dialog and --inset-shadow-border-*. Also migrates --shadow-1/2/3/4 from the brief numeric naming period.

transforms.name: migrate-token-names
transforms.title: Migrate renamed design tokens
transforms.description: Renames color tokens from the v0.0.6 naming audit (positive→success, negative→error, divider→border, etc.).

transforms.name: migrate-badge-children-to-label
transforms.title: Migrate XDSBadge children to label prop
transforms.description: Converts <XDSBadge>content</XDSBadge> to <XDSBadge label={content} />.

transforms.name: rename-banner-variant-to-container
transforms.title: Rename Banner variant → container
transforms.description: Renames the `variant` prop on XDSBanner to `container`, and updates type references from XDSBannerVariant to XDSBannerContainer.

transforms.name: rename-endslot-to-endcontent
transforms.title: Rename Button endSlot → endContent
transforms.description: Renames the `endSlot` prop on XDSButton to `endContent`. Also renames `endSlot` in object literals passed to components that forward props to XDSButton (e.g., XDSDropdownMenu button prop).

transforms.name: migrate-token-renames
transforms.title: Migrate token names to v0.0.8 naming convention
transforms.description: Renames tokens from v0.0.6 intermediate names to final v0.0.8 names per the token spec.

transforms.name: remove-size-props
transforms.title: Remove size prop from StatusDot and ProgressBar
transforms.description: StatusDot and ProgressBar now have a single fixed size (8px). Removes the `size` prop from JSX, object literals, destructuring patterns, and cleans up size type imports.

transforms.name: add-is-icon-only
transforms.title: Migrate pre-v0.0.12 icon-only buttons to XDSIconButton
transforms.description: Converts implicit icon-only <XDSButton icon={...} label="..." /> (v0.0.11 pattern) to the explicit <XDSIconButton> component introduced in v0.0.12. Also adds isIconOnly to forwarding component object configs.

transforms.name: toolbar-density-to-size
transforms.title: Migrate XDSToolbar density to size
transforms.description: Replaces `density="compact"` with `size="sm"` and removes `density="default"` (md is the new default) on XDSToolbar components. Also handles Storybook args/argTypes objects that reference the density prop.

transforms.name: icon-name-deprecations
transforms.title: Rename icon names (checkCircle → success, xCircle → error)
transforms.description: Replaces "checkCircle" and "xCircle" with their preferred equivalents "success" and "error".

transforms.name: rename-attachments-to-drawer
transforms.title: Rename XDSChatComposerAttachments to XDSChatComposerDrawer
transforms.description: Renames `XDSChatComposerAttachments` component and type to `XDSChatComposerDrawer`, renames the `attachments` prop to `drawer` on `XDSChatComposer`, and updates CSS class references from `xds-chat-composer-attachments` to `xds-chat-composer-drawer`.

transforms.name: rename-action-props
transforms.title: Rename on*Action props to *Action
transforms.description: Renames `onChangeAction` → `changeAction`, `onClickAction` → `clickAction`, `onPressedChangeAction` → `pressedChangeAction`, and `onScrollToTopAction` → `scrollToTopAction` to align with the React 19 Action prop naming convention.

transforms.name: rename-section-wash-to-muted
transforms.title: Rename Section/Toolbar variant "wash" to "muted"
transforms.description: Renames `variant="wash"` to `variant="muted"` on XDSSection and XDSToolbar to align with XDSCard which already uses `muted` for the same background token.

transforms.name: rename-status-variants
transforms.title: Rename status variants positive/negative → success/error
transforms.description: Renames static status values written directly on imported StatusDot, AvatarStatusDot, Icon, SVGIcon, ProgressBar, and Badge JSX elements. Indirect values are left unchanged for manual migration.

transforms.name: rename-date-picker-to-input
transforms.title: Rename DateTimePicker/DateRangePicker → DateTimeInput/DateRangeInput
transforms.description: Renames `XDSDateTimePicker` to `XDSDateTimeInput` and `XDSDateRangePicker` to `XDSDateRangeInput`, including props types, import paths, and JSX usage.

transforms.name: rename-isStreaming-to-isStopShown
transforms.title: Rename ChatComposer/ChatSendButton isStreaming to isStopShown
transforms.description: Renames the `isStreaming` prop to `isStopShown` on `XDSChatComposer` and `XDSChatSendButton`. The prop controls whether the stop button is shown — the new name describes the affordance rather than implying a streaming state.

transforms.name: rename-imperative-ref-to-handleRef
transforms.title: Rename imperative ref props to handleRef
transforms.description: Renames imperative `ref` usages to `handleRef` on components whose `ref` prop now points at the root DOM element. Also renames `XDSSideNavCollapseButton` `sideNavRef` to `handleRef`.

transforms.name: rename-stack-element-to-as
transforms.title: Rename element → as on Stack components
transforms.description: Renames the `element` prop to `as` on XDSStack, XDSHStack, XDSVStack, and XDSStackItem for consistency with other polymorphic components.

transforms.name: migrate-item-children-to-endcontent
transforms.title: Migrate item children → endContent
transforms.description: Moves trailing content on `XDSDropdownMenuItem`, `XDSContextMenuItem`, and `XDSSelectorOption` from deprecated `children` usage to the `endContent` prop.

transforms.name: migrate-theme-selectors-to-data-attrs
transforms.title: Migrate XDS theme selectors to data attributes
transforms.description: Rewrites legacy bare prop/state class selectors such as `.xds-button.primary` to preferred data-attribute selectors such as `.xds-button[data-variant="primary"]`.

transforms.name: migrate-selector-children-to-render-option
transforms.title: Migrate selector children → renderOption
transforms.description: Moves custom option renderers on `XDSSelector` and `XDSMultiSelector` from function-as-children to the `renderOption` prop.

transforms.name: drop-xds-prefix-imports
transforms.title: Drop XDS prefix from @xds/core imports (XDSButton -> Button)
transforms.description: Rewrites @xds/core imports and their usages from the prefixed names (XDSButton, useXDSTheme, XDSIconRegistry, XDSButtonProps) to their bare names (Button, useTheme, IconRegistry, ButtonProps), including override keys in a vi.mock/jest.mock factory for an @xds/core module. Only renames bindings imported from @xds/core, leaving unrelated identifiers untouched.

transforms.name: migrate-xds-module-specifiers
transforms.title: Migrate module specifiers from @xds/* to @astryxdesign/*
transforms.description: Updates JS/TS import, export, dynamic import, require, TS import-type, and test-framework mock (vi.mock / jest.mock) module specifiers from @xds/* to the @astryxdesign/* packages used by Astryx v0.1.0.

transforms.name: migrate-xds-declare-module
transforms.title: Migrate declare-module augmentations from @xds/* to @astryxdesign/*
transforms.description: Rewrites the module specifier on TypeScript `declare module "@xds/..."` augmentations to the @astryxdesign/* packages used by Astryx v0.1.0. Only the augmented module path is changed; identifiers inside the augmentation are left untouched.

transforms.name: migrate-xds-css-surfaces
transforms.title: Migrate .xds-* / [data-xds-*] / @layer xds-* CSS surfaces to astryx
transforms.description: Rewrites the documented XDS CSS surfaces to their Astryx equivalents: the `.xds-*` class-selector prefix, `[data-xds-theme]` / `[data-xds-theme-prose]` / `[data-xds-media]` attribute selectors, `@layer xds-theme` / `@layer xds-base` cascade-layer names, and `@import` of @xds/* package stylesheets (scope rewrite, xds.css->astryx.css, theme-daily->theme-neutral) all become their Astryx forms.

transforms.name: rename-text-color-active-to-accent
transforms.title: Rename Text/Heading/Link/Timestamp color "active" to "accent"
transforms.description: Renames the `color="active"` value to `color="accent"` on Text, Heading, Link, and Timestamp. The `accent` value maps to `--color-text-accent` (the dedicated accent text ink). Also updates Storybook color argTypes options and object-literal `color` props in files that import a target component.

transforms.name: migrate-layout-components-to-experimental
transforms.title: Migrate astryx.config layout.components to experimental.xle.components
transforms.description: Relocates XLE app-component registration from the legacy `layout.components` config key to `experimental.xle.components`. String entries (`Name: "@/path"`) are normalized to `{ from: "@/path" }` (named import, key = export name); object entries are carried over unchanged (from/description/default preserved). Bails with a clear migrate-manually error when the config cannot be statically analyzed or when merging would be unsafe.

transforms.name: rename-switch-label-spacing-default-to-hug
transforms.title: Rename Switch labelSpacing "default" to "hug"
transforms.description: Renames the `labelSpacing="default"` value to `labelSpacing="hug"` on Switch. The old value keeps working as a deprecated alias. Also updates Storybook labelSpacing argTypes options and object-literal `labelSpacing` props in files that import Switch.

transforms.name: migrate-table-tableprops-to-direct-props
transforms.title: Migrate Table tableProps to direct root props
transforms.description: Lifts object-literal `tableProps` keys on <Table> into sibling JSX props (className, style, id, aria-*, data-*, event handlers). Dynamic or colliding entries are kept and annotated with a TODO comment.

transforms.name: rename-table-renderprops-styles-to-xstyle
transforms.title: Rename Table render-prop `styles` field to `xstyle`
transforms.description: Renames the `styles` StyleX-array field to `xstyle` on Table plugin render-prop objects (TableRenderProps, HeaderRowRenderProps, HeaderCellRenderProps, BodyRowRenderProps, BodyCellRenderProps, ScrollWrapperRenderProps) inside plugin transform functions. Reads (`props.styles`) and writes (`styles: [...]`) are renamed; unrelated `styles` bindings (e.g. from stylex.create) are left untouched.

transforms.name: rename-avatar-size-scale
transforms.title: Rename Avatar named sizes tiny/xsmall/small/medium/large → xsm/sm/md/lg/xl
transforms.description: Renames static sizes written directly on imported Avatar and AvatarGroup JSX elements. Indirect values are left unchanged for manual migration.

transforms.name: remove-tablist-orientation
transforms.title: Remove TabList orientation prop (misleading no-op)
transforms.description: The `orientation` prop is removed from TabList in v0.2.0. It did not produce a vertical tab strip; it only changed the keyboard-hint arrow badge. Arrow navigation already accepted both axes regardless. This codemod strips the prop from all <TabList> usages. No behavior change.

transforms.name: migrate-dialog-position-to-logical
transforms.title: Migrate Dialog position left/right to logical start/end
transforms.description: Rewrites <Dialog position={{left, right}}> to {{start, end}}. start/end map to inset-inline-start/end and mirror under RTL; the physical left/right are deprecated (still work, removed in a future major). Optional — adopt at your own pace.

transforms.name: unwrap-authoring-factories
transforms.title: Unwrap authoring create* factories into plain stamped objects
transforms.description: Rewrites createConfig/createIntegration/createComponentDoc/createFunctionDoc/createDoc/createPageTemplate/createBlockTemplate/createCodemod/createConfigCodemod calls to the plain object they returned (stamping the doc/template/codemod `type` discriminant), and removes the now-dead factory imports. Authoring is types + parsers in v0.3.0 — there are no factories.

transforms.name: migrate-authoring-imports
transforms.title: Repoint authoring imports to @astryxdesign/cli/authoring
transforms.description: Rewrites imports/exports (incl. dynamic import and TS import-type) from the removed authoring surfaces — @astryxdesign/cli/{config,doc,integration,template,codemod} and @astryxdesign/core/{authoring,config} — to the unified @astryxdesign/cli/authoring entrypoint. Bindings are unchanged; only the module specifier moves.

transforms.name: rename-authoring-doctypes
transforms.title: Rename authoring doc field types to explicit domain-prefixed names
transforms.description: Renames the doc field types (PropDoc, ThemingTarget, ComponentVar, DerivedVar, ElementDescriptor, GroupDoc, TranslationDoc, ExampleDoc, AnatomyElement, BestPractice, PlaygroundConfig, ContentBlock, TokenPreviewType) to their Component*/Reference* equivalents in imports, type references, and JSDoc import() type refs. The authorable entry types (ComponentDoc/HookDoc/ReferenceDoc/TemplateDoc) are unchanged.

transforms.name: rename-radiogroup-arialabel-to-label
transforms.title: Rename aria-label → label on RadioGroup menu components
transforms.description: DropdownMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioGroup, and BreadcrumbMenuRadioGroup now take a required `label` prop (applied as aria-label) in place of the old optional `aria-label` passthrough. This codemod renames `aria-label` to `label` on those three components only. `aria-labelledby` is left as-is — pass it via base props when a visible label already exists.

transforms.name: rename-topnavheading-href-to-headinghref
transforms.title: Rename TopNavHeading href to headingHref
transforms.description: Renames the removed TopNavHeading href alias to headingHref.

transforms.name: migrate-grid-minchildwidth-to-columns
transforms.title: Migrate Grid minChildWidth to columns.minWidth
transforms.description: Rewrites <Grid minChildWidth={n}> to <Grid columns={{minWidth: n, repeat: "fit"}}> where safe.

transforms.name: migrate-navmenuitem-to-navheadingmenuitem
transforms.title: Rename NavMenuItem to NavHeadingMenuItem
transforms.description: Rewrites the removed NavMenuItem alias and its props type to NavHeadingMenuItem.

transforms.name: migrate-lab-codeblock-imports
transforms.title: Repoint lab CodeBlock imports to core
transforms.description: Moves CodeBlock imports from @astryxdesign/lab to @astryxdesign/core/CodeBlock.

transforms.name: remove-theme-transition-token-imports
transforms.title: Remove deprecated transition token imports
transforms.description: Removes import specifiers for transitionDefaults, transitionRaw, transitionVars, and TransitionVarName.

transforms.name: rename-dropdown-menu-radio-dot-target
transforms.title: Rename the removed dropdown-menu-radio-dot theme target
transforms.description: Renames the `dropdown-menu-radio-dot` theme target (and the `astryx-dropdown-menu-radio-dot` class it rendered) to `radio-indicator-dot` / `astryx-radio-indicator-dot`. Menu radios draw the shared radio indicator now, so the menu-specific dot target no longer exists. The new target is app-wide rather than menu-only, so each rewritten site gets a TODO comment to confirm that widening is intended.

transforms.name: migrate-table-rowexpansion-to-tree
transforms.title: Migrate tree-mode useTableRowExpansion to the tree plugin
transforms.description: Rewrites the removed useTableRowExpansionState tree pattern to useTableTreeState + useTableTreeData. Detail-panel usage (renderExpanded) is left untouched.

transforms.name: rename-menu-divider-data-types
transforms.title: Rename the menu divider data types to *DividerData
transforms.description: Renames `DropdownMenuDivider`, `ContextMenuDivider`, and `BreadcrumbMenuDivider` — the `{type: "divider"}` option types — to `DropdownMenuDividerData`, `ContextMenuDividerData`, and `BreadcrumbMenuDividerData`. The bare names now belong to the new compound divider components. Imports used as values are left untouched.

transforms.name: banner-collapsible-content
transforms.title: Rename Banner's `defaultIsExpanded` to the `collapsible` config
transforms.description: Banner's collapse axis is now a single `collapsible?: boolean | CollapsibleConfig` prop. Rewrites `defaultIsExpanded` to the equivalent config (`{defaultIsOpen: true}`), and drops `defaultIsExpanded={false}`, which is the default. Banners that never set the prop are untouched — the default is unchanged. Pass `collapsible={false}` for content that is always visible.

transforms.name: migrate-astryx-theme-selectors-to-data-attrs
transforms.title: Migrate Astryx theme selectors to data attributes
transforms.description: Rewrites known v0.5.4 `.astryx-<target>.<value>` selectors to behavior-preserving class/data-attribute unions.

transforms.name: move-ime-helper-import
transforms.title: Move isImeKeyEvent imports to core utilities
transforms.description: Moves `isImeKeyEvent` from the deprecated client-only hooks barrel to the canonical `@astryxdesign/core/utils` path.

transforms.name: remove-focus-isrtl-option
transforms.title: Remove explicit RTL options from focus hooks
transforms.description: Removes deprecated `isRtl` properties from inline useGridFocus and useListFocus option objects. Direction is detected from the container.

transforms.name: rename-resizable-pixel-bounds
transforms.title: Rename useResizable pixel bounds
transforms.description: Renames deprecated `minSizePx`/`maxSizePx` properties to `minSize`/`maxSize` in static inline useResizable configurations and marks objects with spreads or computed properties for manual migration.

transforms.name: migrate-theme-catalog-to-descriptors
transforms.title: Give each integration theme a typed descriptor instead of the manifest.json catalog
transforms.description: Writes <name>Theme.doc.mjs beside each theme the catalog lists, then removes the catalog.

transforms.name: migrate-native-picker-to-presentation
transforms.title: Migrate nativePicker to presentation
transforms.description: Renames `nativePicker` to `presentation` on DateInput, DateTimeInput, and TimeInput, mapping touch→adaptive-native, always→native, and never→adaptive-bottom-sheet (text-input for TimeInput). Dynamic values are left for manual migration; the deprecated prop still works.

transforms.name: migrate-copied-themes-to-descriptors
transforms.title: Give copied app themes their local descriptors
transforms.description: Writes one unmaintained same-stem descriptor beside each earlier theme copy in src/themes.

transforms.name: migrate-deprecated-theme-surface
transforms.title: Migrate removed component theme aliases and selectors
transforms.description: Renames all 21 removed component target aliases in static theme maps and CSS, and replaces target-qualified bare prop/state classes with reflected data attributes.

transforms.name: validate-data-token-ownership
transforms.title: Validate data-token ownership
transforms.description: Reports generated theme CSS that still emits the canonical data-color defaults at :root, so it can be rebuilt with `astryx theme build`.

transforms.name: migrate-field-input-styling
transforms.title: Migrate input root styling to container/control parts
transforms.description: Renames root `xstyle`/`className`/`style` on Field-composed inputs to the `control*` or `container*` part they styled before.

transforms.name: preserve-bottom-sheet-content-padding
transforms.title: Preserve BottomSheet content padding
transforms.description: BottomSheet now pads its content like Dialog. Adds `padding={0}` to BottomSheet elements that do not set `padding`, keeping their previous unpadded content box. Sheets whose only child is a Section or Layout are left unchanged; they render identically. A sheet with a nested Layout anywhere in its content also gets a TODO comment, because padding={0} removes the inset between that Layout's regions and the Layout's own padding restores only its outer edges. Remove `padding={0}` and your own inset to adopt the theme padding. An app whose theme already sets `bottom-sheet` padding on every edge is not affected by the new default; the transform cannot see the theme, so remove the added `padding={0}` there to keep the theme inset.

transforms.name: rename-empty-search-results-text
transforms.title: Rename emptySearchResultsText to emptySearchText
transforms.description: Renames the removed `emptySearchResultsText` prop to `emptySearchText` on imported Tokenizer, Typeahead, and BaseTypeahead elements, and the same key on trigger objects written inline in ChatComposerInput's `triggers`. Leaves a TODO where the new name is already set, on every spread onto these elements, where the triggers value is not written inline, and on a trigger object with a spread or computed key.

transforms.name: migrate-list-edge-compensation-to-edge
transforms.title: Migrate List edgeCompensation to edge
transforms.description: Renames `edgeCompensation="inline"` to `edge="outset"` on List, and drops `edgeCompensation` beside an `edge` string. Keeps the old prop with a TODO where `edge` is computed or a later spread may override it, on a dynamic value, and where the List also spreads props; the deprecated prop still works there.

transforms.name: migrate-codeblock-tokenizer-to-language
transforms.title: Migrate CodeBlock tokenizer to a custom language
transforms.description: Replaces `tokenizer={fn}` beside a static `language="x"` with `language={createCodeLanguage({name: 'x', identifiers: ['x'], tokenize: fn})}`. Keeps the old prop with a TODO where the language is computed, missing, or `plaintext`, and where the CodeBlock also spreads props; the deprecated prop still works there.

transforms.name: promote-tokenizer-presentation
transforms.title: Move Tokenizer's removed experimental presentation to presentation
transforms.description: Rewrites `experimental={{presentation: x}}` on Tokenizer to `presentation={x}`; Tokenizer no longer reads `experimental`. Leaves a TODO where the experimental value is not an object literal, where the Tokenizer already passes presentation, and where it spreads props.
